Apothecary’s Helper

You learned the smell of good medicine and the patience of people waiting for it.

Which remedy always reminds you of someone?

Rules

Type: Background. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Scholarship 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.d2131c1e1e2a8d2e.JournalEntryPage.6f80563d010710d7]{Identify a Mixture}. - Medicine 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.b106c6212cacb290.JournalEntryPage.62f92a67d857f95c]{Relieve Poison}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +10 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
